column1: # Stage S8 X8 — the S8 switch: the single-page app, the one outside consumer of the map engine, imports the rendering and streaming crates directly, and the map engine's and graphics engine's re-export shims go with both legacy crates. Paths name the tree before the moves.

# three `streaming::bridge` modules are `map_streaming_model` modules. Prose spellings without a
# trailing segment (`map_engine::frame`) and Markdown are rewritten by hand.
